product_goal: Dead-simple microSaaS: user uploads their messy resume/CV history, gets one clean consolidated resume typeset in LaTeX ('Overleaf but simpler'), free on-screen preview, PDF download gated behind a one-time Stripe payment. Eventual: Next.js frontend deployed on Netlify, Convex backend, Google OAuth. CLI (pipeline.py) is the reusable core engine underneath all of that.
sequencing_constraints: CLI maturity (this repo) comes before the fullstack web layer.
Convex backend and Google OAuth are explicitly deferred by the user — do not build them until the user asks.
Deploy target is Netlify; frontend will eventually be Next.js.
Never build competitor features with no proven willingness-to-pay signal — check research_findings before adding scope.

research_findings.summary: Across 8 resume-tool competitors (Zety, Resume.io/LiveCareer, Teal, Rezi, Kickresume, Enhancv, Resume Worded, Jobscan, Careerflow), the single most common paywall is gating the FINAL DOWNLOAD/EXPORT (PDF/Word), not the building/editing itself.
research_findings.implication: v1 monetization should gate PDF download, keep on-screen preview + consolidation free.

research_findings.summary: One-time pricing ($9-19, Rezi-style) converts a cold single-session visitor far better than subscriptions; the trial-then-autorenew dark pattern (Zety/LiveCareer) is the #1 source of negative reviews in the category.
research_findings.implication: Use Stripe one-time Checkout for v1, not a subscription. This is also a differentiator, not just a shortcut.

research_findings.summary: Job-description-paste -> tailored keyword match/highlight is the proven 'wow' hook for Teal and Jobscan, and is cheap here: just another LLM call against the already-structured JSON profile.
research_findings.implication: Good candidate for a paid add-on once the core download-gate MVP ships, not required for v1.

research_findings.summary: ATS keyword-scoring engines, LinkedIn optimizers, auto-apply/job-tracker features, template marketplaces, and human expert review are all commoditized, out of scope for this tool's 'consolidate my resume mess' angle, or too service-heavy to ship fast.
research_findings.implication: Do NOT build these for v1 even though competitors monetize them — no evidence they fit this product's wedge.
